applicable_endpoint.description: W&B Inference (CoreWeave Serverless Inference) OpenAI-compatible host
applicable_endpoint.parser_rule: Do not invent a second URL parser. An unrecognized endpoint fails closed and does not inherit this policy.

rates_usd_per_million_tokens.basis: highest non-Pro DeepSeek per-million-token rates listed on the provider pricing page on 2026-11-17; leans high

projection.note: 40 thousand output tokens; the reasoning stream is billed

operator_attestation.note: Only the operator can read the Billing page, so only the operator writes this file, from an interactive terminal prompt (there is no command-line or non-interactive way to confirm). This is a speed bump, not a security boundary: a process running as the same OS user can still write the file directly. Treat a hostile same-user process as out of scope, or move the attestation behind a separate OS user or a signed record.
